verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean shared left edge and a sensible order (brand → headline → subcopy → pills → CTA), but the headline wraps with 'here' orphaned on its own line, the right half and bottom band are mostly empty, and the cut-off peach circle sits off on its own. B fails on several points. The headline runs almost to the right edge and doesn't line up with the left edge of SOLSTICE and the subcopy. The CTA floats off to the right between the subcopy and the pills, so the flavour pills end up below the button and the reading order breaks. The headline and subcopy also sit partly on top of the big circle, and the layout feels random and cramped.
